key_insight: The neural basis method separates fixed neural representations from physics-based projection, enabling scalable Navier–Stokes solution and operator learning.
engineering_relevance: Shared basis coordinates turn parametric flow prediction into coefficient prediction without explicit spatial dependence, supporting scalable fluid-model surrogates.
method: Define a representation space using fixed neural basis functions.
Project the governing equations to determine expansion coefficients.
Learn parameter-to-coefficient maps with a velocity-only residual that provides an a posteriori velocity-error estimate.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical analysis and numerical experiments showing improvements over baselines in accuracy, efficiency, generalization, and scalability, but gives no quantitative results.
watch_item: Performance on new flow regimes may depend on how well the fixed basis spans their solutions; basis-selection details are not provided in the abstract.
paper_title: Solving and Learning Navier-Stokes Dynamics with the Neural Basis Method
